97636e93f38a11cd94a2.en: There are 7 days in a week.

603bc9f9492e23baeb49.en: After Sunday, the week starts again with Monday.
603bc9f9492e23baeb49.id: Setelah Sunday, minggu baru dimulai lagi dengan Monday.

cbc9e2b1f686f8381afa.en: There are 12 months in a year.

5ac2f8c6fbaa2e4d7115.en: Yesterday is the day before today. Tomorrow is the day after.
5ac2f8c6fbaa2e4d7115.id: Yesterday berarti kemarin, yaitu hari sebelum hari ini. Tomorrow berarti besok, yaitu hari sesudah hari ini.

8ec4e847b25ce5939fbe.en: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and so on.
8ec4e847b25ce5939fbe.id: Urutan harinya Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, dan seterusnya.

52a7d3b3cb7578d48982.en: There are 12 months in a year, from January to December.
52a7d3b3cb7578d48982.id: Ada 12 bulan dalam satu tahun, dari January sampai December.

5048ca0d6e791cf6f398.en: The months go January, February, March in order. January is first.
5048ca0d6e791cf6f398.id: Urutan bulannya January, February, March. January yang pertama.
